_comment: A broken cavalry block whose flight meets a long wall bears off round its ends before it gets there. Team 0's 64 horses (default Cavalry geometry for 64: 8 files by 8 ranks, about 280 wu wide and 840 wu deep, file pitch 40 wu, rank pitch 120 wu) spawn ALREADY routing (starting_state 3, morale 1.0) facing north, their own back edge, centred on x 1000 with their front rank at y 1980. A wall of block terrain (x 700-1300, y 1650-1770) stands 210 wu ahead across the whole line of flight, reaching 160 wu past the block's flank files on either side. Each man runs for his own back edge on his own (SoldierFlightStep); when he looks round and sees the wall along his way as far as he can see, he runs the open way nearest it, turning first to his own side of his unit's centre (SoldierLookRound.way_round_rock), so the western files bear off west and the eastern files east. Measured with dense 2-tick FULL dumps on seeds 0 to 4 (identical: nothing here draws on the seed), measured 2026-11-13 on #1949's branch: no rider is at the wall (within a body radius plus 1 wu) at ticks 240 and 300 (pinned), 1 is at tick 350, and none is inside it at any declared tick (pinned at ticks 240, 300 and 350). The men's centroid, which the unit's position reads while they rout, stands at (1007.25, 1932.28) at tick 350 (pinned), from (1000.0, 2399.5) at tick 8; a flight held at the wall would leave it near y 2190. The bottom-up flight (#1949) removed the unit-level detour and the slot grid the slot_distance_max pins (0 within 120 wu at ticks 300 and 350, #1924) measured: a routed man has no slot. A routing unit's rout timer (6 s) runs out at tick 360 and it rallies; the clip ends at tick 352, just before that. An idle team-1 infantry company (30 men) 700 wu to the east keeps the router in the close sim tier; all_teams_control leaves both sides without AI. Drill mode. Driven live through the real SelectionManager by tools/demo/DemoInputRecorder.gd; world coordinates; physics ticks (60/s).
